name: @nanowork/desktop
description: 纳米Work行业版 Windows / macOS 安全桌面客户端

scripts.verify: npm run icons && npm run check:build-config && npm test
scripts.pack: npm run verify && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run verify && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run verify && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run verify && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
